# REQ: LANG-2571 LANG-2572
# @version ^0.4.0
event Greeted:
    who: indexed(address)
owner: public(address)
count: public(uint256)
@deploy
def __init__():
    self.owner = msg.sender
@external
def greet(times: uint256) -> String[32]:
    self.count += times
    log Greeted(msg.sender)
    return "Hello"
